corrected_answer: Assumptions and scope (variant 185): the hang is an unverified symptom; use an authorized disposable allocation, a finite watchdog, redacted telemetry, and no production changes. Confounders include collective-order bugs, stale rendezvous state, topology asymmetry, interface selection, GPU faults, resource pressure, clock skew, and instrumentation overhead. Change one reversible variable at a time, stop on unsafe symptoms, and roll back any override; evidence is insufficient for a root-cause claim until artifacts reproduce the distinction.
